description: Universal Content Manifest schema for Kinetic blog post generation. Used across all phases to define batches of Pillar + Spoke posts. Phase-specific completed manifests are written to blog/data/completed/phase{N}.json.

_field_conventions.null: Kinetic derives this value during Batch 0 (manifest completion step).
_field_conventions.empty_string: Human must fill before generation begins.

fields.title: string — Post H1 title. Maps from h1_title.
fields.slug: string — URL-safe path segment. Maps from slug.
fields.content: string — Full post body as sanitized HTML.
fields.excerpt: string — Plain-text summary (1-2 sentences). Maps from one_sentence_summary.
fields.meta_keywords: string — Comma-separated SEO keywords. Derived from primary_keyword + cluster context.
fields.reading_time: integer — Estimated reading time in minutes.
fields.kinetic_id: string — Unique Kinetic-side identifier for deduplication.
fields.featured_image_url: string — Full URL to the featured/hero image.
fields.featured_image_alt: string — Alt text for the featured image.

_post_schema.cluster: integer (1-7) — Which topic cluster this post belongs to.
_post_schema.cluster_id: string — Cluster slug for the admin backend. Must match _cluster_id_map.
_post_schema.primary_keyword: string — The exact GSC target keyword this post must rank for.
_post_schema.h1_title: string|null — Full title containing the primary keyword.
_post_schema.slug: string|null — URL-safe path derived from primary_keyword + target_city.
_post_schema.intent: string — Search intent classification. Split on ' / ' to resolve tone via intent-matrix.json.
_post_schema.parent_post: string|null — primary_keyword of the parent pillar. null for pillars.
_post_schema.sibling_posts: array|null — Array of primary_keyword values for sibling spokes. null for pillars.
_post_schema.one_sentence_summary: string|null — Inline teaser sentence containing the primary keyword.
_post_schema.target_city: string — Primary city. Must match a city in geo-reference-matrix.json.
_post_schema.target_neighborhood: string|null — Neighborhood from neighborhood-matrix.json for the target_city.
_post_schema.target_landmark: string|null — Landmark from landmark-matrix.json near the target_neighborhood.

posts._example: PILLAR POST — one per cluster per phase
posts.h1_title: The Ultimate Oregon Roof Maintenance Guide: Defeating Moss in the PNW

posts._example: SPOKE POST — multiple per cluster, links back to parent pillar
posts.h1_title: 2026 Salem & Portland Roof Cleaning Cost Guide
